title: Content Researcher & Social Media Strategist for an Early-Stage Tech Startup
description:
About us

Noito Choice Innovations is a small technology company building social platforms around a different idea of how people find what they need.

Most of the time, finding a good answer means searching, scrolling, and sifting through whatever the algorithm pushes to the top. We want to make it in a way that you say what you need in your own words, and you get an answer that fits your situation. Our products are built around requests like that, using a small amount of AI to understand what someone is really asking and connect it with the people and knowledge that can help.

We also believe useful knowledge doesn’t only come from the loudest voices on social media. Someone with first-hand experience, a niche skill, or a good local tip can be the best answer to your question, and they deserve a place where that knowledge gets noticed.

Privacy is part of the foundation. When people trust a social space, it can support more than everyday conversation. It can support real collaboration and the exchange of data in ways that help research projects move forward, with privacy protected along the way.

The team behind this has backgrounds in research and industry: Software engineering, autonomous systems, and sensor data, and attempting to be guided by freelancers in business strategy, economics and marketing . We care about clean engineering, shipping in small steps, and building things people can rely on.

Learn more at noito.xyz.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a creative and curious person who enjoys technology and knows how to find interesting stories behind it. You don't need to be working in IT, but you should be comfortable researching topics such as AI, digital products, privacy, automation, and emerging technologies.

Rather than simply reposting news, we want someone who can explain why a development matters, connect it to real-world problems, and suggest how we can contribute our own perspective as a company.

Your responsibilities

- Research relevant technology news, articles, research, and industry developments.

- Turn these findings, together with our company's development progress and product features, into a weekly content plan for LinkedIn and Instagram.

- Suggest practical post ideas, opening hooks, captions, and calls to action, along with any third-party visual content, that can be re-posted, to accompany the posts.  Include the references to all third-party content. 

- Prepare clear briefs reporting to us what product screens of our own products, workflows, or development activities to capture for short videos and other content. 

- Suggest simple carousel and static-post concepts. 

- Adapt ideas to LinkedIn vs Instagram .

- Maintain a lightweight content calendar.

How we would work together

I'd share updates about what we're developing, upcoming features, and the direction of the company. You would combine that information with your research to propose the stories worth telling.

For example, a development in AI agents might inspire a discussion about automated services, followed by a practical demonstration of a relevant feature in our mobile app LupaChoice. Another week, a small product improvement or an interesting technical challenge might become the main story.

The goal is to build a coherent narrative about the company over time, not to publish content just for the sake of staying active.

Expected deliverables

We will split the job onto milestones. The first milestone will extend through 4 weeks, and will be dedicated for short calls to make the product features and company goals understandable to you. It will also be a trial for both of us of how well we collaborate. 
For the  initial four-week trial, we'd expect:
One core content idea per week (i.e., four content ideas in total), according to the specified requirement determined in the contract. The most important in the first month is making progress with the alignment of our goals, rather than delivering a perfect content calendar and content idea descriptions.

The next milestones will be assessed and paid weekly. Every week, 2-3 content ideas with the post suggestions and references for articles and visuals will be expected. We would think that you will use 2-3 hours per content idea, but this might be our poor judgement, so please be so kind to inform us in your proposal of the estimated time you think a task like this will need. Then we will agree on the objectives together, to not exceed your time limits or our budget.

The work should be organized and practical enough that we can execute your plan and design the static visuals and publishable four LinkedIn articles or Instagram posts ourselves, with the guidance of an AI chatbot. 

Who would be a good fit?

- Someone with experience in content research, social media strategy, technology writing, or startup marketing.

- Someone who can explain technical topics in clear, natural language.

- Someone curious enough to find relevant stories without relying entirely on trending topics.

- Someone comfortable working independently with a founder and adapting as an early-stage product evolves.

- Someone who uses AI tools thoughtfully to improve research and productivity, while checking sources and adding original judgment.

Budget and arrangement

The budget for the paid four-week trial is approximately $140. For the time forward, the budget will be approximately 240$ per four weeks. The initial scope should fit that budget, and we can discuss a sustainable workload and longer-term collaboration based on the results.

When applying, please share a couple of examples of relevant content research, editorial planning, or technology-related posts you've worked on. We'd also appreciate a brief example of how you would turn a recent technology development into a story for an early-stage startup.

As founder, I'm interested in finding someone who can become a reliable creative partner as the company grows.
